title: Over The Sunset Sea
firstLine: Darkness is falling, the night draweth nigh,

lines: Darkness is falling, the night draweth nigh,
Shadows fall dark on the lea;
Voices of saved ones are beckoning come,
Our hearts are heavy as they journey on,
Jesus is waiting to welcome them home,
When my long journey on this earth is o'er,
Dear Lord, I'm coming to Thee;
Ever to rest in that heavenly home,
Soon I shall journey to heaven my home,
And from all sorrow be free;
Harbor lights gleaming are lighting the way.
